## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? What user story is behind it?

Example: "As a homelab admin, I want to be able to … so that I can …"

## Proposed solution

What you'd like DomainSentinel to do.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Out-of-scope for the MVP

If the feature is complex, can it be split into a smaller MVP that fits the project's "no over-engineering" philosophy?

## Additional context

Screenshots, links, related projects, etc.
